narrative.overview: Extracted from frontend/app.css, frontend/index.html and frontend/app.js after the user's explicit PlayerCard reference superseded the rejected neutral-black direction. Navy/blue, bundled Inter, compact overlay rail, ruled settings, semantic switches and prepared quick motion. Native OBS verification is separate from source and isolated-fixture evidence.

rules.name: Reference authority
rules.body: The user's established PlayerCard palette and controls override generic skill palette or gradient bans.

rules.name: Prepared motion
rules.body: Entries run for real loaded content on navigation and tray reopening, never routine state refresh.

rules.name: Reader boundary
rules.body: The pointer-transparent bottom fade covers only the content reader and disappears proportionally at its end.

dos: Use actual native state for save readiness
Preserve dirty edits and reveal hotkey recovery
Keep startup staged on by default
donts: Do not return to the rejected black/white world
Do not import XP, artwork or fake metrics
Do not confuse fixture screenshots with native capture proof
